The COMPOUNDING_EDGE_CAPTURE hypothesis proposes that by identifying and capturing the compounding edge in the market, we can improve the overall performance of the trading strategy. This edge is characterized by a sequence of winning trades that compound on each other, resulting in a significant increase in profit.

## Mechanism

The mechanism for capturing the compounding edge involves identifying the specific market conditions and trade characteristics that are associated with this edge. This includes analyzing the market structure, trend, and volatility to determine the optimal entry and exit points for trades. The strategy will also incorporate a risk management system to ensure that the compounding edge is captured while minimizing losses.
